title: Matched T8 temporal extension at R512 and R1024
scientific_question: After completing the T1/T2/T4 matrix, do matched T8 runs at R512 and R1024 continue temporal convergence and cause the R512-R1024 spatial gap to stabilize, reverse, or continue increasing?

spatial: R512-R1024 pooled bottom-flux RMSE at T1/T2/T4/T8
temporal: R512 T4-T8 pooled bottom-flux RMSE and T2/T4/T8 descriptive order
R1024 T4-T8 pooled bottom-flux RMSE and T2/T4/T8 descriptive order
interaction: T4-T8 temporal shift at each spatial resolution divided by T8 spatial gap
resolution dependence of T4-T8 temporal shift

adjudication.T8_TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_SPATIAL_GAP_REVERSE: Both T4-T8 temporal shifts decrease relative to T2-T4, both remain below the T8 spatial gap, and T8 spatial gap is smaller than T4.
adjudication.T8_TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_SPATIAL_GAP_CONTINU: Both T4-T8 temporal shifts decrease and T8 spatial gap is larger than T4.
adjudication.T8_TEMPORAL_PROGRESS_SPATIAL_GAP_STABILI: Both T4-T8 temporal shifts decrease and T8/T4 spatial gaps are numerically equal within 1e-12.

next_logic.if_spatial_gap_stabilizes_or_reverses_wi: A matched R2048 spatial extension at T8 may be considered prospectively.
next_logic.if_spatial_gap_continues_increasing_whil: Temporal interaction is still shaping the spatial estimate; continue to T16 before R2048.
next_logic.if_temporal_progress_fails: Diagnose Reference temporal/nonlinear behavior before any spatial or LARE extension.
